# 0x03: AL MAC (6), interface count (1), then each interface: MAC (6), media type (2, big-endian), info length (1), info (length octets).
# 0x04: tuple count (1), then each tuple: MAC count (1), followed by that many MAC addresses (6 octets each).
# 0x06: local interface MAC (6), then zero or more neighbor MAC addresses (6 octets each); no count octet.
# 0x07: local interface MAC (6), then zero or more neighbor AL MACs (6) and flag octets (bridge bit 7, reserved bits 6-0); no count octet.
